lede: The biggest thing on the civic calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale preliminary public hearings covering a cluster of new buildings in Backman Village, and that kind of project deserves eyes in the room. Also on Tuesday, San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, drilling into zoning, density, and regulatory incentives aimed at getting more workforce housing built. Between the fair, the Hardrock Hundred, and a full slate of music and markets, the valley is humming.
